before.t: By progressively querying routers about the next router on the path to B using ICMP packets, starting with the first router
By requiring each router to append the address to the ICMP packet as it is forwarded to B. The list of all routers en-route to B is returned by 13 in an ICMP reply packet
By ensuring that an ICMP reply packet is returned to A by each router en-route to B, in the ascending order of their hop distance from A
By locally computing the shortest path from A to B

fixes.reason: Traceroute sends probes with TTL 1, 2, 3, ...; each router en route returns ICMP Time Exceeded to A, in ascending hop order (option C). Previous key A (routers queried about the next router) does not describe traceroute. Previous key was solver-derived, not official.

fixes.before: Option B text 'returned by 13' is a misprint of 'returned by B'. A vs C debated; official key taken as A.
fixes.after: Key changed A -> C on a technical argument: traceroute uses increasing TTL so each router returns ICMP Time Exceeded in ascending hop order (C); A ("querying routers about the next router") is not how it works. No reliable official 2005 IT key located; some sources give A. Verify.
